products.title: Toblach nappa leather booties
products.description: These sporty, minimalist booties are inspired by the iconic Prada Linea Rossa style, an archive design presented at the 1998 Fall/Winter runway show. The innovative, hybrid character of the original design is recalled by the revolutionary rubber soles, while nappa leather adds a sophisticated touch of modernity. The sleek footwear with a tapered silhouette is decorated with the distinctive Linea Rossa logo.
